patch.description: Update own profile: `displayName` (no step-up) and the login identifiers `username` / `email` (never `role`, `status`, `communityId`). Changing `username` or `email` requires `currentDerivedKey` (the `POST /v2/auth/password` step-up) in the same request: a missing, wrong, throttled or stale credential is one uniform `403 { error: 'Forbidden' }`. Normalisation and uniqueness are the admin user-management rules (`deriveUserIdentityColumns`, guarded identity write, PostgreSQL identity advisory locks in the order community → identity → users); a collision is `409 { error: 'Conflict' }`; bounds `username` ≤ 254, `email` ≤ 254 (valid address). The content-free `auth.identifier.change` audit row commits in the same unit as the write. Other sessions are kept (the credential is unchanged and the revocation trigger does not list these columns)

post.summary: Upload media file as a **raw request body**
post.description: Upload media file as a **raw request body** (#249; no multipart; ≤100 MB on Workers Free; larger media uses `/v2/media/uploads`, #286). `Content-Type` is the declared media type; `Content-Length` is required on Workers; `x-content-sha256` (client-computed lowercase/uppercase hex) is required; query parameters `filename` (required), `role`, `ownerType`, `ownerId`, `metadata` (JSON string) carry the rest, and unknown or duplicate parameters are `400`. Storage verifies the digest outside application code (R2 `sha256` put option on Workers; native `node:crypto` on Node): a mismatch is `422` with no `File` row and no stored bytes. Allowed types (Rails parity, magic-byte sniffed on the first 8 KiB): jpeg/png/webp/gif; mp3/wav/ogg/m4a/webm/flac/`audio/aac` (alias `audio/vnd.dlna.adts`, `audio/x-aac`); mp4/webm/ogg/quicktime video; plus `image/tiff` and `image/heic` (category `image_download`, 25 MiB) and `application/pdf` and docx (category `document`, 25 MiB). `document` and `image_download` types are accepted only for `story_media`; `place_photo` also accepts `image_download` (legacy Rails TIFF place photos); all other photo/branding/map roles stay browser-renderable images. Every media response is `Content-Disposition: attachment` + `nosniff` + CSP `sandbox`, so pdf/docx/tiff/heic are never inline-rendered. Only the first 8 KiB is read for MIME sniffing and extension/content agreement; size is capped by `Content-Length` (`413`) and re-checked against the stored object size. Server-generated `storageKey`; creates private staging `File` for `own-editor`/`own-admin`; for `own-viewer`/`own-member` and null-community `super_admin` uploads, must bind/identify the explicit typed `user_photo` relation for `actor.id` before/at staging (no untyped staging `File`)

post.summary: **Create a direct multipart upload session** for media above the 100 MB single-request ceiling
post.description: **Create a direct multipart upload session** for media above the 100 MB single-request ceiling (#286). JSON body: `filename`, `contentType`, `size`, `sha256` (whole file), `partSha256[]` (one SHA-256 per part), optional `partSize` (16-64 MiB, default 16 MiB) and the same `role`/`ownerType`/`ownerId`/`metadata` binding fields as `POST /v2/media`. Same authority, type/extension rules and `user_photo` binding as `POST /v2/media`; per-type caps for this route: video 512 MiB, audio 200 MiB, others as for `POST /v2/media`. Stages a tenant-scoped server-generated key, returns `{ id, mode, expiresAt, partSize, partCount, maxBytes, parts[{ partNumber, method, url, headers, size }] }`. `mode: presigned` (Workers): per-part SigV4 URLs on the R2 S3 endpoint, 2 h TTL, signing the part `Content-Length` and `x-amz-content-sha256` (the hex part digest, over an `UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD` canonical request); each part target's `headers` carry the exact values the client must send; `mode: api` (Node): part targets point at `PUT /v2/media/uploads/:id/parts/:partNumber`. `501` when the Workers deployment has no R2 S3 credentials; `413` above the cap; `400` for type/extension/part-digest problems

delete.description: Abort the upload: aborts the multipart upload, deletes staged parts, journal and object (only while no `File` row owns them). `204`; `404` for unknown/finished sessions

post.description: Complete the upload: body `{ parts: [{ partNumber, etag }] }`. Assembles the object (R2 `CompleteMultipartUpload` through the binding, or streamed concatenation on Node), verifies stored size against the session and the first 8 KiB type signature, re-runs authorization, applies the §6.7 reuse rule and creates the `File` row (and `user_photo` binding) exactly like `POST /v2/media` (`checksum` is verified on Node and null on Workers); response is the `POST /v2/media` `201` body. `400` missing/mismatched parts or signature, `404` unknown/other-tenant/finished session, `409` row already exists, `410` expired session, `422` size or (Node) whole-file digest mismatch; every failure removes the staged object

put.summary: Send one part through this API
put.description: Send one part through this API (`mode: api` only, Node profiles). Uploader only. Requires the exact part `Content-Length` and the `x-amz-checksum-sha256` header from the part target; storage verifies the part SHA-256 (`422` on mismatch). Responds `200` with the part `etag` (also the `ETag` header). `409` for `presigned` sessions (their parts go to R2)
